subject: Post-call: confirm economic owner, payment flow & procurement kickoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: confirm economic owner, payment flow & procurement kickoff

Hi Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can get procurement moving: 

1) Recap (from our call):
- You’re planning a pilot covering 50 clinician seats for Q4.
- Success criteria: <10% friction on clinician workflow and 95th percentile latency under 250ms.
- Preferred billing cadence: consolidated monthly invoice to AP.

2) Immediate asks we need to close procurement: 
- Economic buyer: who will sign/approve the PO (name and email)?
- Procurement intake: does Meridian use a vendor portal (Coupa/Ariba) or do you accept emailed vendor intake forms?
- Invoicing details: billing address, AP contact, standard net terms (we saw net 60 mentioned in passing).
- Security evidence: who on your security/compliance team should we send SOC2 & data flow docs to?
- PO timing: target date for PO issuance so we can reserve capacity in Dedicated if needed.

I’ve attached our vendor intake form for your convenience. Marcus has also put together a short procurement checklist (attached) with the typical redwood artifacts your procurement team usually asks for.

Proposed next step: if you can reply with the econ owner + AP contact + security contact, we’ll prepare a minimal procurement packet (SOC2 summary, data flow, support SLA) and a one-page SOW for signatures. Happy to schedule a 20-min alignment with procurement next week if that helps.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: vendor_intake_form.pdf
From: Tom Keller <tkeller@meridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: confirm economic owner, payment flow & procurement kickoff

Thanks Kimberly — great summary. Answers below: 

- Economic buyer: Aisha Rahman, CFO (aisha@meridianhealth.com). She will sign the PO.
- Vendor portal: we primarily use Coupa; vendor onboarding goes through the portal but procurement will accept a completed intake form if you prefer. 
- Invoicing: Send invoices to ap@meridianhealth.com. Bill to: Meridian Health, P.O. Box 710, Portland, OR 97201.
- Payment terms: Our standard is Net 60 after invoice receipt.
- Security contact: cc’ing our InfoSec intake alias (infosec@meridianhealth.com) — they will request the SOC2 report and a short data flow diagram.
- PO timing: Procurement expects to issue a PO the week of Oct 18 if we have the intake completed and SOC2 evidence in place.

I’ve also attached the vendor portal instructions in case you need to register there. Once we’re in Coupa, procurement can create the PO directly.

Tom Keller
Head of Procurement, Meridian Health
tkeller@meridianhealth.com
Attachment: meridian_vendor_portal_instructions.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: confirm economic owner, payment flow & procurement kickoff

Tom — perfect, thanks for the quick answers and for looping Aisha and InfoSec. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

- We will complete the Coupa vendor registration this afternoon and upload the intake form.
- Marcus — can you prepare the SOC2 summary and a one-page data flow diagram to share with infosec? Target: EOD Oct 5.
- Lauren — can you prepare a one-page SOW and a simplified usage table for the pilot so Aisha has the cost breakdown?

Tom — would you prefer a short procurement kickoff next Wednesday (Oct 13) at 10am PT to walk procurement through the packet, or would an email bundle suffice?

Also: if there are any special PO fields Meridian needs (funding code, cost center, PO approver ID), please paste them in reply so we can pre-fill the Coupa form correctly.

Thanks —
Kim

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Tom Keller <tkeller@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T07:50:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 summary + procurement packet for Meridian pilot

Hi team — attaching the artifacts Tom requested. Quick list of what I uploaded: 

- SOC2_report_redwood_summary.pdf (short summary + controls matrix) 
- DataFlow_onepage.pdf (high-level data flow and retention notes) 
- procurement_checklist.xlsx (list of typical procurement asks + who owns each item)

Notes for Meridian procurement: the SOC2 summary includes our auditor contact if procurement needs evidence directly from the auditor. Data sent to Redwood for the pilot will be pseudonymized at rest and encrypted in transit; retention defaults to 90 days for pilot logs unless you request otherwise.

Kimberly — I’ve left placeholder fields in the checklist for PO number, cost center, and preferred invoice remittance. Tom — if you can populate or confirm those fields we’ll finalize the Coupa registration.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: SOC2_report_redwood_summary.pdf; procurement_checklist.xlsx
From: Tom Keller <tkeller@meridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@meridianhealth.com>, infosec@meridianhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-05T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 summary + procurement packet for Meridian pilot

Kim/Marcus — received everything, thank you. Aisha confirms she’s comfortable with the pilot economics and will be the PO approver. Our procurement team will create the Coupa vendor record once you upload the intake; I completed the intake draft and attached it here. 

PO metadata to pre-fill:
- Cost center: HEALTH-OPS-23
- Funding code: FND-Q4-47
- Invoice remit: ap@meridianhealth.com

We expect to issue the PO the week of Oct 18 — can you pencil in Oct 20 for a technical kickoff? If anything changes I’ll update you.

Tom Keller
Head of Procurement, Meridian Health
Attachment: vendor_intake_completed_meridian.pdf
